interpretation.units: Blender meters, Z up. Boundaries are topological boundaries, not automatically visually open holes.
interpretation.caps: Seven silver ribs and front rail have caps but each evaluated curve cap is a disconnected component with coincident boundary edges. They are visually capped; do not describe 96 edges as missing end faces. Welded rebuild should give zero boundaries.
interpretation.unsealed_tubes: Two corner columns and seven blue rib insets are genuinely uncapped open tubes; ten stone seams are also uncapped but tiny decorative inlays.
interpretation.rear_glass: Six rear panes end at X +/-6.34, Z0.53..4.85. They fill the center only and leave broad outer apertures. No perimeter infill closes them to the outer rounded arch. Seven mullions end at Z5.035 without a continuous head bar.
interpretation.corner_column_feet: Feet at Z0.22 exceed terrazzo top Z0.1735 by 0.0465m, or silver/base top Z0.15 by 0.07m where outside the terrazzo rounded border.
interpretation.glass_roof: Six single-face canopy panes have zero thickness by design and 24 total boundary edges; source thin_glass=True. A precision shell rebuild can use shallow solids or a deliberately documented two-sided glass contract.
interpretation.portal: There are 6 independent rounded tube rings on two gate faces and 2 extra full-passage tube rings. None are exact duplicates, but they read as overlapping nested piping; a closed extruded ring section would communicate a single structural doorway.
interpretation.inside_preservation: Audit reads only the 3 assigned architectural owners, no exhibits or furnishings.
